title: Bootshaus Sommerfest Closing
sourceDescription:
Electro/EDM vs. Deep/TechHouse vs. Techno vs. DnB/Trap/Dubstep

Every summer needs a proper goodbye.

On September 19th, we’re closing the season the only way we know how, with a full-club night across Mainfloor, Blckbx, and Dreherei.

Expect one last summer highlight filled with long sets, high energy, and the unmistakable Bootshaus atmosphere. A final chance to dance, connect, and celebrate before the nights get longer and colder.
